convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for DigVariation indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator with non-standard parameters cannot be auto-converted.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

other_exits: Sell position closed when DigVariation[1] < DigVariation[2] (uptrend detected)
Buy position closed when DigVariation[1] > DigVariation[2] (downtrend detected)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of available margin/balance applied via MM parameter

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads 3 consecutive values from DigVariation buffer (indices SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2). Direction is determined by comparing Value[1] vs Value[2]: if Value[1]<Value[2] the indicator is rising (uptrend), if Value[1]>Value[2] it is falling (downtrend). Within an uptrend, entry long requires Value[0]>Value[1] (continuation signal). Within a downtrend, entry short requires Value[0]<Value[1] (continuation signal). Signal is computed once per new bar (or on bar 0 when SignalBar=0). Opposite-side close is gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans. Opposite-side open is gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec and passed to trade functions, likely for position magic/identification. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of DigVariation custom indicator logic (source not included, only iCustom call). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar, GetStartBars) must be ported or replaced with standard MT5 Python API calls. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides GetStartBars and Smooth_Method mapping only. Position sizing logic with 5 MarginMode variants needs careful translation. Signal logic uses 3-bar lookback from indicator buffer - straightforward to replicate once indicator values are available. Entry/exit boolean gates (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) allow selective disabling of each trade direction and close action.
